address: Domaine du Baguier, 435 chemin du Baguier, La Roquebrussanne, 83136, France
bio: Close to Loube Mountain and Sainte-Baume Mountains, this modern vineyard restaurant cultivates the tradition of delicious Provençal cooking, offering an opportunity to sample typical slow-cooked dishes, such as pieds paquets and beef stew, or a contemporary take on dishes that have their roots in the local terroir (einkorn wheat risotto and seasonal mushrooms; purple artichokes in barigoule with smoked bacon). Here you can sit down to enjoy hearty, indulgent cuisine that pairs well with the estate's organic wines from the Coteaux Varois appellation. The guestrooms are also a convenient base for hiking in and around this secluded corner of the Var.
